messages:

Subject: Compliance checklist & next steps for SOC 2 / FedRAMP interest

Hi Matt —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment from both sides.

Call highlights (short):
- Primary ask: understand Redwood’s handling of PHI/PII for a small subset of CareBridge services (patient summaries + analytics).
- Compliance posture you care about: SOC 2 (Type II), HIPAA BAA, GDPR data processing, and longer-term interest in FedRAMP Low for certain cloud-hosted modules.
- Team stakeholders you mentioned: Lydia Park (Infosec), Ben Ortiz (Platform), and legal for BAA/contract redlines.

Information we need from you to scope the engagement:
1) Completed vendor security questionnaire (or the matrix you started) — helps us size effort and scope for SOC2 control mapping.
2) Confirmation of systems/applications that will be in-scope for PHI processing (which environments: prod only or prod+staging).
3) Preferred timelines (target date for SOC 2 Type II or readiness window).
4) Any pre-existing compliance docs (network diagrams, prior audits, penetration testing reports).

What Redwood will deliver once we proceed:
- Draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that sequences activities (BAA, questionnaire responses, technical deep-dive, policy gap remediation) — we’ll share a first draft within 3 business days.
- A scope options memo: SOC 2-only vs SOC 2 + ISO 27001 alignment vs SOC 2 as prep step for FedRAMP evaluation.
- Proposed timeline and resource estimate (engineering/infosec hours).

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Please send the vendor security questionnaire you have — we can pre-fill our answers to reduce your lift.
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with your Infosec/Platform leads (recommend: Lydia + Ben).
- Redwood to share MAP draft and a short checklist (attachments: MAP draft + high-level security profile).

If that sounds good I’ll drop the MAP draft and a calendar invite for next week (suggest Tue/Wed afternoon PT).

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. Shared answers below and attached the questionnaire (CareBridge_Security_Questionnaire_Feb2027.pdf). Forwarding to Lydia to confirm the technical availability.

Quick answers from our side:
- SOC 2: We completed a readiness assessment in Q4 2026 and plan to start Type II audit engagements in Q3 2027; priority for us is mapping Redwood’s controls to our SOC2 scope.
- HIPAA: We handle PHI in a defined production namespace; yes — we will require a BAA.
- GDPR: We are an EU data controller for a subset of users; standard contractual clauses in place with our processors.
- FedRAMP: Interested for a later stage (platform module only). We want to treat this as a longer-term goal — SOC2 first.

Files attached: CareBridge_Security_Questionnaire_Feb2027.pdf (questionnaire, partial answers included). I’ll follow up with Lydia and Ben on availability for the technical deep-dive — Lydia is copied.

Matt Sullivan
Head of Vendor Risk
CareBridge Health
matt.sullivan@carebridge.com
